Shortly afterward, his estranged wife, Emily, arrived unexpectedly at his home, having learned of false rumors that he was seeking a new wife. unit: Brought to Brierley by mistake instead of a boy, Nell quickly won over Obed Abernethy and eventually his sister Thirza, who decided to keep her at Grey Shutters. She settled into the community, naming local landmarks with imaginative titles, making a bosom friend in Isolde Pembroke, and entering Brierley School. Her early years at Grey Shutters were marked by energetic scrapes, including an outburst at neighbor Agatha Sowerby over her red hair, accidentally getting Isolde drunk on homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, and confessing to stealing a brooch she had merely misplaced. At school, she engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow, which escalated into a slate-smashing incident after he mocked her hair. She subsequently left school briefly in protest of the teacher's punishment, but returned and successfully advanced to the higher grades. Nell excelled academically and socially, organizing a story club and performing in local concerts. When Obed Abernethy died suddenly following the failure of the Abbey Bank, Nell gave up an opportunity to attend college immediately and took up teaching at Brierley School to support Thirza and keep Grey Shutters. During her time teaching, she saved the life of little Posy Fay Pembroke during an attack of croup, helped establish the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and accidentally dyed her hair green before cutting it short. Later, after winning the Avery Scholarship at Regent's Academy in Portmaris, she earned her First Class teacher's license and pursued an Arts degree at Wexcombe College alongside friends Honora Hollis, Mabel Colby, and Cressida Lindsay, residing at Tabby's Place. After resolving her lingering grudges with Hugh Carrow, Nell realized her true love for him, rejected a marriage proposal from Cyril Lisle, and eventually accepted Hugh's proposal in Dinah Wren's old garden. She gave up her scholarship to stay at Grey Shutters when Thirza's eyesight began to fail, taking the local teaching position in Brierley after Hugh selflessly yielded it to her.
